notes.title: Patch: New Special Abilities
notes.content:
[p]A new patch has been deployed, and the introduction of special abilities is here!

Open up the Skill Tree at the start of the demo and choose the ability that suits your playstyle:

• Skill: Impact

Gives +10 penetrative damage for a duration.

• Skill: Slow Motion

Slows down time by 75% for a limited time.

• Skill: Shield

Creates a momentary shield, that protects you from incoming fire.


I hope you enjoy this new addition. Onwards![/p]
